witness_review.branch: Left-side parking with explicit device-permission comparison
required_context: Establish highway dedication and public use, roadway and shoulder boundaries, two or more clearly marked vehicular lanes and one-direction restriction.
Establish restriction-device instructions, official status and governed parking space.
Establish restriction-device instructions, official status and governed space, and inventory any express official permission for this standing or parking.
Establish the qualifying vehicle's actual left-side position and the selected person's connection to parking.
Place the qualifying vehicle's intended parking location on its left-hand side within the roadway.
Preserve the scene prerequisite: hazardous-place designation and angle-parking permission are not implied by the generic control.
Realize the road as a public, laned one-way roadway without changing the parking task.
Record any express permission and actual halt purpose and loading activity.

Record purpose and actual passenger or merchandise activity. Hazardous-place designation and angle-parking permission are not implied by the control. Preserve unresolved device-conformity and previous-line references.
witness_review.reason: The generic road permits compatible construction of a laned one-way segment and left-side parking governed by the fixed restriction device.
